limitations: This is a sampled CPU attribution, not an estimate of removable CPU or an unprofiled benchmark
Percentages in profile categories are shares of worker CPU, not percentages of a CPU core
User call stacks sometimes end early despite recognized leaf symbols; unspecified memory copies/comparisons are not assigned to a single caller
The retained CPU-clock periods agree with process CPU within 2%; sampling and timer accounting are not identical
No equal-work before/after trial or power/fan conclusion is made
Captures replaced in the mailbox still perform necessary EVDI acknowledgements; they cannot simply be dropped before grabbing
Full-screen damage counts cover emitted frame records, not all captures
